question: Which of SZA's Hot 100 hits has she never played at an NYC show?
answer:
Based on fan-logged setlists on setlist.fm (2022–2025) joined with Billboard Hot 100 chart data (`shows`, `songs_played`, `artist_chart_credits`, and `chart_songs`), SZA has performed several major hits in NYC, but has never logged a full live performance of several others. 

Her highest-peaking Hot 100 hits that she **has never played** at an NYC headline show (excluding partials, teasers, or snippets) include:

1. **"Slime You Out"** (with Drake) — Peak #1 (charted Sept 2023)
2. **"What Lovers Do"** (with Maroon 5) — Peak #9 (charted Sept 2017)
3. **"No Love"** (with Summer Walker) — Peak #13 (charted Nov 2021)
4. **"Telekinesis"** (Travis Scott feat. SZA & Future) — Peak #26 (charted Aug 2023)
5. **"Hit Different"** (feat. Ty Dolla Sign) — Peak #29 (charted Sept 2020)
6. **"Beautiful"** (DJ Khaled feat. Future & SZA) — Peak #29 (charted Sept 2022)

*(Note: SZA's major solo hits like "Kill Bill", "Snooze", "Good Days", and "Shirt" have all been played during her NYC stops, such as her Madison Square Garden and Barclays Center shows on the SOS Tour).*

args.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT cs.title, cs.peak_position, cs.first_chart_week
FROM artist_chart_credits acc 
JOIN chart_songs cs ON acc.performer = cs.performer
WHERE acc.artist_mbid = '272989c8-5535-492d-a25c-9f58803e027f'
  AND cs.first_chart_week <= (SELECT max(show_date) FROM shows WHERE artist_mbid = '272989c8-5535-492d-a25c-9f58803e027f')
  AND cs.title NOT IN (
    SELECT sp.chart_title FROM songs_played sp 
    JOIN shows s USING (show_id)
    WHERE s.artist_mbid = '272989c8-5535-492d-a25c-9f58803e027f' AND sp.chart_title IS NOT NULL AND NOT sp.is_partial
  )
ORDER BY cs.peak_position ASC;
